title: GrantRegister
description: LibreDB's reviewed rows that grant an engine's claims (docs/providers/CONTRACT.md, clauses M-54 and M-84): a list of rows, each keyed by the engine and either a package's name, version and digest or the legacy key of an engine Studio still serves through its legacy adapter.

row.description: One engine's grants under one key, which is the engine and exactly one of `legacy` and `package`.

legacy.description: The legacy key: the row describes Studio's own code for an engine its legacy adapter serves, and is deleted as the engine moves into a package of its own.

engine.description: The engine id the row grants, in the form of an engine id of the providers lock.

packageKey.description: The package a row is reviewed for, in the forms of the providers lock: a new version or digest has no row until it is reviewed.

digest.description: The digest the providers lock admits for the package (docs/providers/CONTRACT.md, clause C-93), over its files as the host walks them, not over its tarball, one digest per package version on every platform: sha256: and 64 lower-case hex characters.

keyword.description: One SQL keyword as the confirmation gate compares it, in the form of the SDK manifest's sqlKeyword: an upper-case letter, then up to 63 upper-case letters, digits or underscores.

grants.description: What the row grants: one member per claim, each in its claim's vocabulary, and every member required, so no grant is left out by omission.

writeReach.description: The write reach granted: open, guarded while the connection is read-only, or none.

readsFileAccessPosture.description: Whether the engine's editor handle opens under the caller's file access posture, read by its provider.

deniedFileAccessRefusal.description: The sentence a connection is refused with when the caller's file access is denied, or null where the provider confines file access itself.

singleWriterFile.description: Whether the engine keeps one handle per database file in the process.

readRootsRequired.description: Whether agent mode and MCP read the engine only beneath the read roots a seed declares.

agentCredentialForm.description: The form of the agent credential the engine signs an agent in with, or null for a user and a password.

maskingExemptColumns.description: The column pattern masking passes over and why, or null where masking exempts no column.

exposable.description: Whether a seed connection of the engine may be exposed to MCP clients.

statementRead.description: Whether an MCP client may run a statement on the engine.

metadataReadChangesState.description: Whether reading the engine's schema for an MCP client changes state the engine keeps, though it writes no data.

agentCredentialRequired.description: Whether MCP reads the engine only under an agent credential of the seed's own, never under the connection's login.

opensLocalFile.description: Whether a connection of the engine opens a file on Studio's own host rather than reach a server.

hostPathFields.description: The connection fields that name a file on Studio's own host which the provider reads.

serverLevelWithoutDatabase.description: Whether a connection that names no database reaches the whole server.

sshTunnel.description: The sentence a connection with an SSH tunnel is refused with, or null where the engine takes one.

agentCredential.description: The agent credential a seed of the engine may carry, or null where it carries none.

form.description: pair is a user and a password, dedicated-pair the same with a user other than the connection's own, and secret a password alone.

supersededBy.description: The connection fields the provider signs in with in preference to a user and a password.

statementLanguage.description: The statement language agent mode sends the engine, by its name, a lower-case letter then up to 31 lower-case letters or digits, or null where it sends none.

agentReadings.description: The curated operational readings agent mode may be offered on the engine, each once, in the order a gate offers them.

catalogReadCommandShaped.description: Whether the statement fence may admit the engine's composed catalog statement by identity, past its read-keyword allowlist, where the engine's agent overlay requests it as a command: granted only where the request is true as well.

servesOneSession.description: Why the engine's connections serve their object tree from one session, the editor's, or null where a tree read may run on a session of its own.

agentExecution.description: Whether agent mode executes statements on the engine.

ownWords.description: Whether the client receives the engine's own words through core's scrub, or only Studio's sentence naming their code.

redaction.description: How the query event log's redacted capture keeps a statement of the engine, granted only for the grammar grammarSha256 names: none keeps nothing of its text, sql keeps it with its literals replaced and the closed names in its name quote, and command has Studio's command reader of the engine answer the text kept, which only a legacy row may grant.

readsSqlText.description: Whether the confirmation gate reads the engine's statement text as SQL, granted false only for the grammar grammarSha256 names, or, for an engine that states no SQL text, where grammarSha256 is null, only for the statement language data languageSha256 names.

confirmExemptForms.description: The keyword sequences, each led by a shared dangerous keyword, that do not ask the confirmation gate on the engine, granted only for the grammar grammarSha256 names.

decidesAlone.description: Whether the engine's statement vocabulary is the confirmation gate's whole answer, granted only for the grammar grammarSha256 names, or, for an engine that states no SQL text, where grammarSha256 is null, only for the statement language data languageSha256 names.

grammarSha256.description: The SHA-256, in lower-case hex, of the canonical text of the grammar LibreDB reviewed the engine's SQL text claims with: the grammar as JSON with no white space, every object's members in ascending code-unit order and every list in its own order. Null where the row reviews no grammar, so every SQL text claim is read at its restrictive value, but readsSqlText and decidesAlone for an engine that states no SQL text, which the row grants under languageSha256 alone.

languageSha256.description: The SHA-256, in lower-case hex, of the canonical text of the statement language data LibreDB reviewed the engine with, in the form grammarSha256 states, or null where the row reviewed the engine as stating none. For an engine that states such data, the statement language, decidesAlone and readsSqlText false are granted only where this is the digest of the data it states.

reasons.description: Why the row grants what it does, by grant member: LibreDB's review notes, each a sentence or more.
